title: A new chapter in targeting kinase enzymes in cancer
title_zh: 针对癌症的酪氨酸激酶酶靶向治疗新篇章
abstract: Inhibitors of tyrosine kinase enzymes have been a cornerstone in precision cancer treatments. Now, targeted protein degraders could reshape therapeutic options.
abstract_zh: 酪氨酸激酶酶抑制剂一直是精准癌症治疗的基石。如今，靶向蛋白降解剂可能重塑治疗方案。
